title: Faultbench can now search manuals offline

source.text: Faultbench can now search HVAC manuals completely offline. No signal in the mechanical room, no problem.

media.name: screenshot.png
media.description: Screenshot showing Faultbench finding a compressor diagnostic procedure with a page citation.

linkedin.text:
Most mechanical rooms have no signal.

That is where techs actually need the manual, so Faultbench now runs its search fully offline. Download the manuals once, then look up a procedure with no connection at all.

Same citations, same page numbers. Don't trust the AI. Check the manual.

instagram.text:
No signal in the basement? Still finds the procedure.

Offline manual search is live in Faultbench.

facebook.text:
You know the drill: you're standing in a mechanical room with no bars, and the answer you need is buried on page 214 of a PDF.

Faultbench now searches your manuals offline, so the lookup works whether you have signal or not.

x.text: Faultbench now searches HVAC manuals fully offline. No signal in the mechanical room, still finds the procedure and the page number.
